grilling.description: Stress-test a plan in rounds of questions. Explore facts yourself, put each decision to the user, and wait for shared understanding before acting.

details.whatItDoes: Turns an uncertain plan into a shared set of decisions by asking questions in rounds before implementation.
details.whenToUse: Use it when you want to challenge assumptions and settle requirements before building.
details.whenNotToUse: Avoid it when decisions are already settled and you want immediate implementation; the skill waits for your answers and confirmation.
details.exampleTask: Stress-test a plan to add skill detail pages to this demo hub before we implement it.
details.author: Matt Pocock

frontend-design.description: Design and implement distinctive, polished interfaces. Use it to improve a working page's typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy.

details.whatItDoes: Builds working frontend interfaces with an intentional visual direction, from typography and color to layout and interaction.
details.whenToUse: Use it to create a page or component, or to give an existing interface a deliberate design pass.
details.whenNotToUse: Avoid it for backend-only work or when no visual changes are wanted; its instructions encourage distinctive design choices.
details.exampleTask: Give this demo skill catalog a cohesive design pass while preserving keyboard access and mobile readability.

ship-it.description: Ship the current change for review: run the tests, commit to a feature branch, open or update the pull request, and wait for its live preview URL.

details.whatItDoes: Runs repository tests, commits intended changes on a feature branch, opens or updates a pull request, and verifies its Azure preview.
details.whenToUse: Use it when a change in this hub is ready for human review on a live preview.
details.whenNotToUse: Do not use it to merge, push to main, or rewrite published history. Shipping requires GitHub access and a configured Azure deployment workflow.
details.exampleTask: Ship this demo hub change as a pull request and return its verified preview URL without merging.
details.author: Ali Soliman and Agentic Skills Hub contributors

microsoft-foundry.description: Deploy, evaluate, and manage Microsoft Foundry agents. Reference content only for this demo; using it requires Azure access and the Azure MCP tools.

details.whatItDoes: Guides Microsoft Foundry agent development, deployment, evaluation, and troubleshooting using workflow-specific references.
details.whenToUse: Use it for Foundry agent or model tasks when you have Azure access and the required Azure MCP tools. It is reference-only in this demo.
details.whenNotToUse: Do not use it for Azure Functions, App Service, or general Azure deployment preparation, or without the required Foundry tools and permissions.
details.exampleTask: Plan a batch evaluation of a sample Foundry agent and identify the required tools and evaluation dataset.
details.author: Microsoft
